inch.definition: n. a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot
inch.translation:
n. 英寸, 身高, 小岛
vi. 慢慢前进, 慢慢移动
vt. 使缓慢地移动

inch forward.translation: 慢慢地前进,一寸一寸地向前移动

inch of candle.translation: [经] (用蜡烛点完为止决定成交的)拍卖

inchage.translation: n. 以英寸为单位的长度[距离]

inche.translation: <马来语>n.先生(相当于英语中的Mr.)

inched.definition: v advance slowly, as if by inches
inched.translation: a. 有英寸刻度的；英寸的

incheon.definition: n. a port city in western South Korea on the Yellow Sea

incher.translation: n. 口径是...英寸的东西

inches.definition:
n a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot
n a unit of measurement for advertising space
v advance slowly, as if by inches

inches switch.translation: [计] 微调开关, 微动开关

inchest.definition: v. t. To put into a chest.

inching.definition: v advance slowly, as if by inches
inching.translation: n. 微调尺寸；寸动；点动；缓动

inchmeal.definition:
n. A piece an inch long.
adv. Little by little; gradually.
inchmeal.translation: adv. 逐渐地, 徐徐地

inchoate.definition: s only partly in existence; imperfectly formed
inchoate.translation:
a. 刚开始的, 不成熟的, 未发达的
[经] 不完整

inchoate instrument.translation: [法] 空的单据, 空白支票

inchoation.definition: n. Act of beginning; commencement; inception.
inchoation.translation: n. 起初, 发端, 肇始

inchoative.definition:
n. aspect with regard to the beginning of the action of the verb
s. beginning to develop
inchoative.translation:
a. 起初的, 发端的, 表始的
n. 表始状态, 表始动词

inchoatively.translation: a. 发端的；起初的；表始的 (inchoative的变形)

inchon.definition:
n. a port city in western South Korea on the Yellow Sea
n. a battle in the Korean War (1950); United States forces landed at Inchon
inchon.translation: n. 仁川（韩国西北部一港口）

inchworm.definition: n small hairless caterpillar having legs on only its front and rear segments; mostly larvae of moths of the family Geometridae
